description: Routing cases for the top_scorers football tool. Provider availability and season-safety behavior are verified by offline unit tests.

cases.query: Who are the top 10 scorers in the Premier League for 2025/26?

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a named league and explicit season to top_scorers; API-Football is the runtime primary provider.

cases.query: Find the leading goal scorers in the Premier League.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes a scorer query; the offline unit test verifies missing API_FOOTBALL_KEY activates safe SportScore fallback.

cases.query: Who were the top scorers in the Premier League in the 2018/19 season?

metadata.what_it_tests: Preserves the explicitly requested historical season; unit tests ensure unverified SportScore current data is never substituted.

cases.query: Get the top scorers in the Premier League this season.

metadata.what_it_tests: Routes to the tool; an offline unit test verifies structured data_unavailable output when both providers fail.
